deadline.value: There is no single application round; doctoral posts are offered through professors' positions or projects.
deadline.quote: there is not a unified application procedure

gre_subject.value: The mathematics doctorate page does not mention the GRE Mathematics subject test.

supervisor.value: A RWTH professor must confirm in writing that they will supervise the candidate before admission.
supervisor.quote: a RWTH professor must issue a written confirmation that he or she is willing to act as the candidate's supervisor

funding.value: The page says professors usually have assistant positions, but does not say most doctoral candidates are funded.
funding.quote: Usually a professor has one or more assistant positions in her/his institute

entry_route.value: Usually a research-university degree equal to a German Master's is needed, and RWTH's International Office checks equivalence.
entry_route.quote: This degree has to be equivalent to a German Master's degree

notes: Department page has no admission, fee, GRE or English rule; university rules apply. Mathematics has no unified procedure, so deadline is Per position.
